column1: # Multi-view word-level register glossary for AFSP (docs/afsp_strategies.md, §3).
# Format: <source_term><TAB><target_term>, one pair per line. For each exemplar
# and for the test source, the entries whose source term occurs in the source
# text are inserted as a preceding "[Terms]" line, directing the model toward the
# intended terminology and archaic register markers.
# The list is a curated seed of high-frequency scriptural and register-bearing
# terms rather than a statistical word alignment. Matching is plain substring
# matching over undiacritised forms; a subsequent revision should align and
# extend the list against the corpus. Word-level weighting is disabled when this
# file is absent or when word_pairs is set to false.
